basic_details.short_information: The Aquaculture Division at ICAR - Central Institute of Fisheries Education (ICAR-CIFE), Mumbai invites applications for one temporary post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the project titled "Characterization and Utilization of Sulfated Polysaccharides Extracted from Red Seaweed, Gracilaria spp., Co-cultured with Penaeus vannamei." The project tenure runs from July 2024 to July 2027 (extension applied till July 2028), offering an emolument of ₹37,000/- per month as per applicable CSIR/ICAR guidelines and the terms and conditions of the project. rows.details: ICAR - Central Institute of Fisheries Education (Deemed University)
Characterization and utilization of sulfated polysaccharides extracted from red seaweed, Gracilaria spp., Co-cultured with Penaeus vannamei

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Aquaculture, Fisheries Science, Marine Biology, Marine Science, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline from a recognized university. The candidate must satisfy the applicable CSIR NET eligibility requirements for the Junior Research Fellow position, as specified in the project sanction and recruitment rules. Research experience in seaweed biotechnology, seaweed cultivation, aquaculture, extraction and characterization of polysaccharides, and biochemical analysis. Experience in antioxidant/antimicrobial assays, shrimp culture, gene expression, and scientific data analysis will be an added advantage. The maximum age limit is 28 Years. The upper age limit is relax-able up-to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. Wherever age-related relaxations are claimed on account of category & previous employment or any other as applicable under GOI norms, the certificates are to be sent along with documents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive an emolument of ₹37,000/- per month, as per applicable CSIR/ICAR guidelines and the terms and conditions of the project. Above position is purely temporary and will end with the termination of the project. The tenure and service conditions for JRF will be governed by ICAR guidelines. content_sections.heading: ICAR-CIFE Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Cultivation and maintenance of red seaweed (Gracilaria spp.) and shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) under experimental conditions. Evaluation of the biological activities and potential applications of extracted polysaccharides, as per the project objectives. Monitoring of water quality, maintenance of experimental systems, and collection and analysis of research data. Preparation of research reports, scientific publications, and project-related documentation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIFE Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form provided in the notification. Send your 10th, 12th, Graduation, Post-Graduation Certificates along with Resume. Send your application to [email protected] before 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The hybrid-mode interview is scheduled to be held on 05.11.2026 at 11:00 AM onwards at ICAR-Central Institute of Fisheries Education (ICAR-CIFE), Mumbai, for the selection of a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a contractual and temporary basis. Only the candidates, who fulfil all the eligibility conditions, will be invited to appear for online interview. All invited candidates are requested to be present 10 minutes before scheduled time on the date of online interview and wait before admitted to session by the admin. The selection will be based on academic performance, research experience and performanceduring the online interview. The decision of Director, ICAR-CIFE, Mumbai will be final and binding in all aspects.
